scope.author: 7db0e7b6-ab88-49e9-9362-a19121c8ebf5 (DEV ESPECIALISTA PEGADA)
scope.description: Full 12-frame grip cycles for two remaining rear combat actions: back_r/Sword and back_l/Axe

accounting.pixellab_note: 0 chamadas PixelLab de produção nesta revisão; custo LLM não informado

contract1_bodyPreservation.details: Both clips preserve 100% byte identity in body256 layers against approved GLM-repaired parent sources (glm-fixes/). Decoded RGBA difference across all 24 frames is exactly 0 in both 256x256 and native 128x128.

contract2_keysAndRepairsIntegrity.details: Structural keys F03/F04/F07 preserved byte-for-byte in both clips. In back_r/Sword, F06 retains the clean chainmail restoration with 0 floating pixels. In back_l/Axe, F02 cleanly receives the axe haft into the reauthored fist without deforming the arm or creating a double glove.

contract3_attackOnlyV1Policy.details: visibleInterval is strictly [2, 8] for both clips. Bookends F00, F01, F09, F10, F11 have 0 opaque pixels in equipment layers, and composite PNGs are 100% byte-identical to the unarmed body.

contract4_fourLayerMasters.details: All 8 Aseprite masters verified on disk with exact declared SHA-256 hashes and correct timings (730 ms for Sword, 1100 ms for Axe).

contract5_kinematicsAndWeaponIdentity.details: back_r/Sword follows diagonal slash arc [355°, 10°, 45°, 80°, 105°, 125°, 120°] using recruit-sword. back_l/Axe follows heavy overhead chop [305°, 320°, 335°, 15°, 80°, 120°, 105°] using militia-axe.

contract6_groundClearance.details: back_r/Sword lowest Y reaches 181 in F07, maintaining 9px clearance above groundY=190. back_l/Axe touches groundY=190 exactly at F07 impact without subterranean penetration, rebounding to Y=188 at F08.

limitations: Inspection conducted through discrete still frames, 4x zooms, layer separations, and tactical 64px scale renders.
Functional Chromium playback verified 730ms (Sword) and 1100ms (Axe) wall-clock timings, one-shot stop at F11, and 1x/0.5x stepping.
Perceptual experience of continuous fluid motion in live game engine runtime remains the prerogative of the creator.
Scope is strictly limited to back_r/Sword and back_l/Axe; does not automatically approve the 28-cell matrix or Unity integration.
